__inputs.name: DS_LEDGER
__inputs.label: ledger
__inputs.description: The PostgreSQL database that ledger ingest fills.

title: ledger: cost per pull request and flow
description: Cost per pull request and flow metrics from the views of @opensoftware/ledger (ADR 0035).

list.name: compute_usd_per_hour
list.label: Compute USD per run hour
list.description: What one hour of a run costs in compute, for example a sandbox.

list.name: platform_usd
list.label: Platform USD in the period
list.description: What the platform cost in the period: servers, licenses.

panels.title: Cost per pull request
panels.description: Inference, compute and platform cost of the period, divided by the pull requests opened in it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH spent AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(usd), 0) AS usd FROM spend_attributed WHERE spent_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND spent_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP),
ran AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(hours), 0) AS hours FROM run_cost WHERE started_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND started_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP),
opened AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pr_flow WHERE opened_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND opened_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP)
SELECT (spent.usd + ran.hours * $compute_usd_per_hour + $platform_usd) / nullif(opened.n, 0) AS "Cost per pull request"
FROM spent, ran, opened

panels.title: Cost per pull request by part
panels.description: The cost per pull request split into inference, compute and platform.

targets.rawSql:
WITH spent AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(usd), 0) AS usd FROM spend_attributed WHERE spent_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND spent_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP),
ran AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(hours), 0) AS hours FROM run_cost WHERE started_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND started_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP),
opened AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pr_flow WHERE opened_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND opened_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP)
SELECT spent.usd / nullif(opened.n, 0) AS "Inference", ran.hours * $compute_usd_per_hour / nullif(opened.n, 0) AS "Compute",
  $platform_usd::DOUBLE PRECISION / nullif(opened.n, 0) AS "Platform"
FROM spent, ran, opened

panels.title: Revert rate
panels.description: Reverted pull requests divided by the pull requests merged in the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_revert))::DOUBLE PRECISION / nullif(count(*), 0) AS "Revert rate"
FROM pr_flow WHERE merged_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND merged_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP

panels.title: Human interactions per pull request
panels.description: Reviews and comments by people per pull request opened in the period.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(human_interactions)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Human interactions" FROM pr_flow WHERE opened_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND opened_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP

panels.title: Unattributed spend
panels.description: Spend that no run names. Send osf.run.id in LiteLLM's spend_logs_metadata to attribute it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE run_id IS NULL), 0) AS "Unattributed" FROM spend_attributed WHERE spent_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND spent_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP

panels.title: Pull requests opened and merged per day
panels.description: Throughput: read it next to the cost and the revert rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, sum(opened) AS "Opened", sum(merged) AS "Merged"
FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', opened_at) AS day, 1 AS opened, 0 AS merged FROM pr_flow WHERE opened_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND opened_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
      UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', merged_at), 0, 1 FROM pr_flow WHERE merged_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND merged_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP) AS days
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT date_trunc('day', spent_at) AS time, sum(usd) AS "Spend" FROM spend_attributed WHERE spent_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND spent_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Median cycle time in hours
panels.description: The median hours of each segment, for the pull requests opened in the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM opened_at - kickoff_at) / 3600) AS "Kickoff to pull request",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM merged_at - kickoff_at) / 3600) AS "Kickoff to merge",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM first_human_review_at - opened_at) / 3600) AS "Pull request to first human review",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM merged_at - first_human_review_at) / 3600) AS "First human review to merge"
FROM pr_flow WHERE opened_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND opened_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP

panels.title: Human interactions per pull request per day
panels.description: The trend should go down as the factory needs people less.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', opened_at) AS time, avg(human_interactions)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Human interactions"
FROM pr_flow WHERE opened_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND opened_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Spend by source
panels.description: Spend of the period by source; unattributed spend is its own line.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source AS "source", sum(usd) AS "Spend" FROM spend_attributed WHERE spent_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND spent_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
GROUP BY source ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Spend by user
panels.description: Spend of the period by user; unattributed spend is its own line.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT user_id AS "user", sum(usd) AS "Spend" FROM spend_attributed WHERE spent_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND spent_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Spend by agent
panels.description: Spend of the period by agent; unattributed spend is its own line.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT agent AS "agent", sum(usd) AS "Spend" FROM spend_attributed WHERE spent_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND spent_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
GROUP BY agent ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Spend by model
panels.description: Spend of the period by model; unattributed spend is its own line.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model AS "model", sum(usd) AS "Spend" FROM spend_attributed WHERE spent_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND spent_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
GROUP BY model ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: The 20 most expensive pull requests
panels.description: Inference cost of each pull request's runs by their share, plus compute.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT url AS "Pull request", title AS "Title", inference_usd + hours * $compute_usd_per_hour AS "Cost"
FROM pr_cost WHERE opened_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND opened_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP ORDER BY 3 DESC, url LIMIT 20

panels.title: Runs by agent type
panels.description: All runs and the top-level runs, by agent type.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT agent AS "Agent", count(*) AS "Runs", count(*) FILTER (WHERE top_level) AS "Top-level runs"
FROM run_cost WHERE started_at >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP AND started_at < $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP GROUP BY agent ORDER BY 2 DESC, agent
